mapper.select: SELECT fu.id AS id, fu.user_id AS userId, fu.village_id AS villageId, fu.business_type AS businessType, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, fu.create_time AS createTime, fu.update_time AS updateTime FROM farm_user fu JOIN `user` u ON fu.user_id = u.id WHERE fu.village_id = #{villageId} ORDER BY fu.id DESC
